text:
Lydia M.: Heads-up: we want to tie the new 'Inference Benchmarks' report launch to a short newsletter + gated webinar. Primary goal: demo signups + ebook downloads. Plan = email + follow-up reminder + webinar invite flow.

Omar V.: agree. propose segments: Bench subscribers (downloaded previous reports), Product-engaged (api calls last 14d), and Cold list (no recent activity). Different CTAs per seg.

Cecilia R.: subject line test ideas:
- S1: "New: Inference benchmarks & cost playbook"
- S2: "How much will inference cost you? Benchmarks inside"
We should A/B by segment.

Lydia M.: creative: hero = benchmark chart snapshot, CTA = Download + Register for webinar. Add a 1-line regional note for APAC times.

Tom (events-bot): Webinar scheduling windows: two live sessions (Americas + APAC). Registration links must append region param. I can create two events and emit webhooks on signups.

Mark (ops): deliverability notes: include List-Unsubscribe, monitor bounces, use separate IP pool for large sends. Throttle 5000/hr.

Omar V.: routing rule: if user registers for webinar, mark `registered_bench=true` and suppress download-only follow-ups. If they download the ebook, tag `downloaded_bench=true`. Either flag suppresses the final promotional email.

Cecilia R.: cadence suggestion:
T+0: newsletter + download (immediate)
T+2: reminder to register (for those who haven't registered)
T+6: last reminder + webinar day-of message (for registrants)
We should send reminders 1 day before webinar and 1 hour before for registrants.

Lydia M.: UTM scheme: utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=bench_launch_2798, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. Omar, can you ensure link builder handles this?

Omar V.: will set link builder. Also plan micro-survey for Cold list in email 2: 1 question, radio buttons (primary barrier: cost/infra/complexity). Short link.

Cecilia R.: subject split strategy: Bench subscribers 60/40 to S1/S2, Product-engaged 50/50, Cold list 70/30 (favor curiosity). Small exploratory cell 5% for a curiosity subject: "We benchmarked 6 models  surprising winner".

Mark (ops): preflight checks: DKIM/SPF ok, seeds will run 12h pre-launch. Also confirm unsubscribe list sync.

Tom (events-bot): webhook behavior: on register -> post to /webhooks/marketing/bench with payload {"email","region","session_id"}. Make sure CRM mapping exists.

Lydia M.: creative detail: include a tiny code block example showing perf metrics query to encourage dev execs to click. Keep it brief.

Omar V.: sample sizes: Bench subscribers=820, Product-engaged=1230, Cold=5400. We'll need to limit Cold sample to control spam risk; propose 30% of Cold initially.

Cecilia R.: split tracking: add campaign id = bench_launch_2798 and sub-id for webinar session. Also track `click_to_register` and `ebook_download` events.

Mark (ops): suppression rules: if bounce or complaint occurs, immediate suppression. Also suppress users with `do_not_contact=true`. Throttle rolling over 48h to protect IP.

Lydia M.: webinar CTA copy per segment: Bench subs: "See deep dives in the webinar"; Product-engaged: "Optimize your deployment"; Cold: "Quick primer + actionable numbers".

Omar V.: A quick note: schedule sends by recipient local time between 10-2. For APAC we fallback to 2pm local if 10-2 window not available.

Cecilia R.: analytics: create a short dashboard tile for conversion funnel: send -> click -> register -> download -> demo request. Also surface region breakdown.

Tom (events-bot): I'll attach registration IDs to CRM lead creation. Also can trigger nurture sequence for registrants who don't attend: 1 follow-up + on-demand recording link.

Mark (ops): include plain-text fallback and alt-text for chart image. Also ensure seed placement shows image renders across clients.

Lydia M.: final checklist: segment lists, creative per segment, utm links, webhooks mapped, suppression rules, send windows, seed tests. Target send next Thursday 10am PT for Americas session.

Omar V.: publishing segments now to #campaign-ops. Dropping sample counts and CSVs.

Cecilia R.: I'll upload creatives & alt-text by 4pm PT. Please review and approve for A/B by EOD.

Tom (events-bot): created two webinar sessions and webhook endpoints. Posting links in 5.

Mark (ops): scheduling preflight 24h before. Will post seed results and spam-scan.

Lydia M.: perfect. thanks team  let's measure ebook CTR and webinar conversion closely and iterate on Cold list copy if open <12%.
